name: Aya
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the radiometric diameter; not three measured axes.
credit: Vilenius et al. (2014), Astronomy & Astrophysics 564, A35; Herschel PACS and Spitzer MIPS thermal radiometry
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 768 (+39/-38) km diameter measured from thermal emission. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Aya is a large icy body in the Kuiper belt beyond Neptune, first catalogued as 2002 AW197.
card: A large icy body in the Kuiper belt.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 768 km diameter measured from its heat. Shape and pole are not measured.
